--path-perms-file.help: - File with path permissions to set (format: `target:octalPermFlags#uid#gid` ; see the non-default USER FAQ section for more details)

--preserve-path.help: - Keep path from orignal image in its initial state (changes to the selected container image files when it runs will be discarded). [can use this flag multiple times]

--preserve-path-file.help: - File with paths to keep from original image in their original state (changes to the selected container image files when it runs will be discarded).

--publish.help: - Map container port to host port (format => port | hostPort:containerPort | hostIP:hostPort:containerPort | hostIP::containerPort ).

--publish-exposed-ports.help: - Map all exposed ports to the same host ports analyzing image at runtime (default value: false)

--publish-port.help: - Map container port to host port analyzing image at runtime to make it easier to integrate external tests (format => port | hostPort:containerPort | hostIP:hostPort:containerPort | hostIP::containerPort )[can use this flag multiple times]

--pull.help: - Pull the target image before trying to run it.

--referrers-api.help: - Enables the [referrers API endpoint](https://github.com/opencontainers/distribution-spec/blob/v1.1.0-rc3/spec.md#enabling-the-referrers-api) (OCI 1.1+). Enabled by default (set to `false` to disable).

--registry-account.help: - Target registry account used when pulling images from private registries.

--registry-secret.help: - Target registry secret used when pulling images from private registries.

--remove-env.help: - Remove ENV instructions for the optimized image

--remove-expose.help: - Remove EXPOSE instructions for the optimized image

--remove-file-artifacts.help: - Remove file artifacts when command is done (note: you'll loose autogenerated Seccomp and Apparmor profiles unless you copy them with the `copy-meta-artifacts` flag or if you archive the state)

--remove-label.help: - Remove LABEL instructions for the optimized image

--remove-volume.help: - Remove VOLUME instructions for the optimized image

--report.help: - command report location (target location where to save the executed command results; `slim.report.json` by default; set it to `off` to disable)

--rm.help: - Remove the container when it exits.

--rta-onbuild-base-image.help: - Enable runtime analysis for onbuild base images (default: false)

--rta-source-ptrace.help: - Enable PTRACE runtime analysis source (default: true)

--run-as-target-shell.help: - Attach interactive terminal to the debug container and run shell as if it's running in the target container environment.

--run-target-as-user.help: - Run target app (in the temporary container) as USER from Dockerfile (true, by default)

--save-to-docker.help: - Save pulled image to docker (default: true) [$DSLIM_REG_PULL_SAVE_TO_DOCKER]

--sensor-ipc-mode.help: - Select sensor IPC mode: proxy | direct (useful for containerized CI/CD environments)

--session.help: - Debug session container name (used for debug sessoin actions).

--show-blogs.help: - Show build logs (when the minified container is built)

--show-clogs.help: - Show container logs (from the container used to perform dynamic inspection)

--show-duplicates.help: - Show all discovered duplicate file paths (default: false).

--show-session-logs.help: - Show logs for the selected debug session (using namespace, pod, target container or debug session container name for k8s or debug session container name for other runtimes).

--show-snippet.help: - show check match snippet (default value: true)

--show-special-perms.help: - Show files with special permissions (setuid,setgid,sticky) (default: true)

--skip-build-context.help: - don't try to analyze build context

--state-path.help: - Slim state base path (must set it if the Slim binaries are not in a writable directory!)

--tag.help: - Custom tags for the output image (multiple instances).

--tag-fat.help: - Custom tag for the fat image built from Dockerfile.

--tar.help: -- Push image from a local tar file.

--target-compose-svc-image.help: - Override the container image name and/or tag when targetting a compose service using the target-compose-svc parameter (format: tag_name or image_name:tag_name)

--target-compose-svc-no-ports.help: - Do not publish ports for target service from compose file

--target-type.help: - explicitly specify the command target type (values: dockerfile, image)

--terminal.help: - Attach interactive terminal to the container.

--top-changes-max.help: - Maximum number of top changes to track (defalt: 20).

--use-docker-credentials.help: - Use the registry credentials from the default Docker config file.

--use-last-image-metadata.help: - Use only the last image metadata for the merged image.

--use-local-mounts.help: - Mount local paths for target container artifact input and output (off, by default)

--use-sensor-volume.help: - Sensor volume name to use (set it to your Docker volume name if you manage your own Slim sensor volume).

--volume.help: - Add VOLUME analyzing image at runtime [can use this flag multiple times]

--with-history.help: - Return EPSS results with historical data. Works with the `lookup` and `list` operations.

--workdir.help: - Custom WORKDIR to use for the debug side-car container.
